verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a `/v1` base URL, but that only mirrors OpenAI-compatible routing. Nothing in the pack documents an API versioning scheme, version lifecycle, or deprecation/sunset policy, so there is no evidence the product delivers this story. Probes found no OpenAPI spec, and the docs index mentions no changelog or deprecation page.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
